newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euris to back Moulinex capital rise - paper.
newsitem.headline: Euris to back Moulinex capital rise - paper.

text.p: French holding company Euris, principle shareholder in Moulinex, will subscribe to any capital increase by the troubled electrical appliance firm, the newspaper Les Echos said in a report to appear on Tuesday.

"It goes without saying that if (Moulinex chairman) Pierre Blayau proposes a capital increase, we will subscribe to it," Jean Charles Naouri, chairman of Euris, said in an interview with the French business daily.
He added he was confident Blayau's three-year restructuring plan for Moulinex would start delivering results soon.
Moulinex announced in July a reorganisation programme that included plans for a capital increase this autumn to offset restructuring provisions and return the company to profit.
Blayau has said the capital increase would be for a slghtly smaller amount than a capital increase carried out by Moulinex two years ago of just under one billion francs.
Under the restructuring, Moulinex plans to slash jobs by 22 percent but, following strong protests by unions, has said it hopes to avoid layoffs through such measures as flexible work schedules.
